$comment: Compatibility bands, relationship types, life path kinds and components. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.compatibility.band.excellent: Excellent (80 and above): the numbers support each other strongly.
blocks.compatibility.band.good: Good (65 to 79): a supportive match with a few areas to work on.
blocks.compatibility.band.workable: Workable (50 to 64): a match that works well with understanding and effort.
blocks.compatibility.band.needs_effort: Needs effort (below 50): the numbers pull in different directions; awareness and patience make the difference.
blocks.compatibility.couple.excellent: As a couple, the numbers point to natural harmony. Shared goals come easily; keep making time for each other.
blocks.compatibility.couple.good: As a couple, there is real support between you. Talk openly about the areas below where you differ.
blocks.compatibility.couple.workable: As a couple, the match works with patience. Respect each other's different rhythms and plan important steps together.
blocks.compatibility.couple.needs_effort: As a couple, your numbers differ a good deal. Many such couples do well; clear communication and shared routines help most.
blocks.compatibility.business_partners.excellen: As partners in business, the numbers support each other strongly. Divide roles by strength and the partnership can grow well.
blocks.compatibility.business_partners.good: As partners in business, there is good support. Agree roles and decision rules early.
blocks.compatibility.business_partners.workable: As partners in business, the match is workable. Written agreements and clear roles prevent friction.
blocks.compatibility.business_partners.needs_ef: As partners in business, the numbers pull apart. Clear contracts and separate areas of control are wise.
blocks.compatibility.parent_child.excellent: As parent and child, the numbers show natural understanding. Encourage the child's own strengths.
blocks.compatibility.parent_child.good: As parent and child, there is good support. Notice where the child differs, and give room for it.
blocks.compatibility.parent_child.workable: As parent and child, the match works with patience. The child may need a different style than comes naturally to the parent.
blocks.compatibility.parent_child.needs_effort: As parent and child, your natures differ. Learning the child's numbers helps the parent understand their needs.
blocks.compatibility.life_path.natural: The life paths are natural partners: they share a rhythm and understand each other easily.
blocks.compatibility.life_path.compatible: The life paths are compatible: different, but complementary.
blocks.compatibility.life_path.challenging: The life paths are challenging together: they want different things, so understanding must be built.
blocks.compatibility.component.driver_harmony: Driver harmony: how the two Mulanks, your everyday natures, get along.
blocks.compatibility.component.conductor_harmon: Conductor harmony: how the two Bhagyanks, your life directions, get along.
blocks.compatibility.component.cross_harmony: Cross harmony: how each person's nature suits the other's direction.
blocks.compatibility.component.loshu_gap_fillin: Lo Shu gap filling: how much each person supplies the numbers the other is missing.
blocks.compatibility.component.life_path_synerg: Life path synergy: how the two Western life paths combine.
blocks.compatibility.component.name_harmony: Name harmony: how the two name numbers get along.
blocks.compatibility.component.kua_group: Kua group: whether you share the same good directions at home.
